verdict.rationale: LlamaParse documents a REST API and SDKs in several languages, but nothing in the evidence shows a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent machine-readable spec. The probe found every common OpenAPI and Swagger path returning 404. The llms.txt file and the docs MCP server are adjacent agent-facing aids, not an API spec, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
